title: Discipline Lead – Special Effects (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Special Effects (SFX) BIM content as it relates to atmospheric, water, flame, pyrotechnic, or mechanical effect systems and documentation delivery. Represents SFX discipline authority for BIM documentation outcomes.
authority_statements: Approve or reject SFX discipline BIM states for use in show/technical and documentation milestones
Sign-off authority for SFX documentation readiness
Authority bounded by SFX scope and enterprise standards
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
responsibilities: Ensure SFX BIM models support accurate, coordinated, and safe technical documentation
Align SFX resources with project milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve safety clearances, maintenance access, and effect envelope integrity
Formally approve SFX BIM models for documentation use based on externalized data
Review SFX data completeness using CSV/Excel extracts
accountabilities: SFX BIM content suitability for documentation outputs (equipment schedules, safety clearance zones, installation details)
SFX participation in BIM coordination workflows
SFX BIM deliverables meeting milestone commitments
approvals: SFX discipline BIM model states approved for documentation use
SFX drawings, equipment schedules, and clearance drawings
inputs: SFX engineering designs, fluid/gas requirements, and effect envelopes
BEP and coordination rules from Project BIM Manager / Coordinator
outputs: SFX drawing sets, equipment schedules, and piping/wiring interfaces
